_how: Open each `source`, press Download, Original size, and save it as design/people/originals/<id>.jpg. Then run `python3 scripts/people.py`. Until then the script builds from the low-res stand-ins in design/people/standins/.
_cast: Two protagonists, one per side, so each page tells one person's story: the shop owner (brands) and the podcaster (creators). Three more creators appear once, as the creators Comarket finds.
